narr: A round of showers and thunderstorms occurred late Monday night into Tuesday morning just ahead of a cold front. Combined lift and better shear resulted in a few strong storms. Moisture pooled, resulting in PWATs climbing above 2 inches areawide, which led to high rainfall rates and some minor flooding in urbanized areas.
ev: Ward Rd near Big Creek was flooded. Estimated at least 4 inches of water across the road.
